svg.title: Geologist — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as geologist, wearing a work jacket and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A pointed geological hammer sits above a low angular rock specimen with one visible sediment layer. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
